title: Senior Cybersecurity Research Engineer / Security Researcher
description:
About the Company Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a 100% Indian cybersecurity startup delivering next-generation security solutions for private industries, government organizations, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and defense establishments. The organization is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and incubated with DSC. Turtleneck focuses on developing advanced cybersecurity capabilities to address evolving security challenges across enterprise and government environments. 
 What Were Looking For We are looking for a curious, technically rigorous professional who can work with complex systems and explore challenging security problems. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills to translate research into actionable findings, reusable tools, proof-of-concepts, and meaningful cybersecurity capabilities. Join Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and contribute to the research and development of next-generation cybersecurity solutions. 
 Job Overview Job Title: Senior Cybersecurity Research Engineer / Security Researcher Company: Turtleneck Systems & Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh Experience: 25 Years Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Industry: Computer and Network Security Department: Cybersecurity / Security Research Vacancies: 1 Salary: Best in Industry 
 Role Summary We are looking for a technically proficient and research-oriented cybersecurity professional with expertise in security research, vulnerability analysis, AI security, reverse engineering, cloud security, and operating-system internals. The ideal candidate will be responsible for investigating emerging security threats, analyzing complex systems, researching vulnerabilities, developing proof-of-concept implementations, and building tools that strengthen next-generation cybersecurity capabilities. This role is suited for individuals who enjoy solving complex technical problems, exploring emerging technologies, and translating research findings into practical security solutions. 
 Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Advanced Cybersecurity Research Research emerging cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and security mechanisms. Analyze enterprise technologies and identify potential security weaknesses. Map research findings to established frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and MITRE ATLAS. Prepare technical research reports, security advisories, and proof-of-concept implementations. 
 2. AI and Emerging Technology Security Investigate security risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and AI-enabled applications. Research prompt injection, jailbreak techniques, RAG poisoning, agentic tool abuse, and multimodal AI security. Contribute to AI-driven security research, automation, and security tooling. 3. Security Framework and Infrastructure Research Evaluate modern security frameworks and infrastructure used in authorized research and adversary simulation. Analyze framework architecture, communication mechanisms, agents, extensions, profiles, and security controls. Identify security weaknesses and opportunities for improving existing research capabilities. 4. Vulnerability and Systems Security Research Investigate memory-safety issues, including stack and heap vulnerabilities, use-after-free conditions, and related weaknesses. Research operating-system security mechanisms, kernel security, and modern mitigation technologies. Develop controlled proof-of-concept implementations to validate findings. Analyze vulnerability chains across applications, operating systems, and enterprise technologies. 5. Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis Perform static and dynamic analysis of binaries, malware samples, and suspicious software components. Use tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, WinDbg, and x64dbg for reverse engineering and debugging. Analyze software behavior and security mechanisms. Develop YARA rules and reusable research artifacts based on analysis findings. 6. Cloud and Infrastructure Security Conduct security research across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Investigate cloud IAM configurations, privilege boundaries, container security, and Kubernetes environments. Analyze CI/CD pipelines, software supply-chain risks, and cloud-native architectures. Identify potential infrastructure weaknesses and recommend security improvements. 7. Application and Document Security Research Investigate vulnerabilities in enterprise applications and commonly used document formats. Research DOCX, RTF, OLE, and related technologies from a security perspective. Analyze publicly disclosed vulnerabilities and emerging enterprise software security issues. Develop controlled proof-of-concept implementations for validated findings. 8. Security Tooling and Proof-of-Concept Development Develop research tools, scripts, utilities, and proof-of-concept implementations using C, C++, Python, Rust, or Go. Apply AI-assisted development techniques to accelerate research and experimentation. Build custom tools when existing solutions do not meet research requirements. Contribute to reusable internal security frameworks and research capabilities. 9. Vulnerability Disclosure and Technical Documentation Research vulnerabilities in security frameworks, enterprise software, and cybersecurity products. Investigate authorization weaknesses, vulnerability chains, remote-code-execution conditions, denial-of-service conditions, and other security-impacting issues. Prepare technical documentation for responsible vulnerability disclosure. Contribute to CVE research, technical advisories, research papers, blogs, and security publications, where applicable. 10. Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Learning Prepare detailed technical reports and executive-level summaries of research findings. Document methodologies, technical observations, proof-of-concept results, impact, and recommendations. Support mentoring and internal knowledge-sharing initiatives. Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, cybersecurity research, technologies, and industry developments. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications 
 Experience and Certifications 25 years of experience in cybersecurity, security research, advanced security engineering, or related technical security domains. OSCP or a related certification such as OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, or CRTP. AI Security Research Knowledge of LLM security, prompt injection, the OWASP LLM Top 10, AI agent security, and RAG security. Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS and emerging AI security threats. Cloud and Infrastructure Security Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, cloud IAM, CI/CD security, and cloud infrastructure security. Security Research and Adversary Simulation Familiarity with security frameworks and tools such as Mythic, Sliver, Havoc, Cobalt Strike, and BloodHound. Understanding of Active Directory security and related research areas. Memory and Operating-System Security Knowledge of memory corruption, exploit development, shellcode, ROP/JOP, kernel security, and security mitigation analysis. Understanding of Windows and Linux internals, process architecture, PE format, system calls, and kernel debugging. Familiarity with Windows security mechanisms, including Defender, AMSI, ETW, and firewall security. Reverse Engineering and Malware Analysis Experience with Ghidra, IDA Pro, WinDbg, or x64dbg. Understanding of static and dynamic binary analysis, reverse engineering, and malware analysis. Programming and Tool Development Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, Rust, or Go. Ability to develop scripts, utilities, research tools, and proof-of-concept implementations. Security Frameworks Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP, and PTES.

Key Skills: Artificial Intelligence,Ida PRO,Analysis,Security Framework,Security,Senior,Simulation,Malware Analysis

 Must have

title: Staff Engineer - IT
description:
R1 RCM Inc. is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management services which transform and solve challenges across health systems, hospitals, and physician practices. Headquartered in Chicago, R1 is a publicly traded organization with employees throughout the US and international locations. Our mission is to be the one trusted partner to manage revenue, so providers and patients can focus on what matters most. Our priority is to always do what is best for our clients, patients, and each other. With our proven and scalable operating model, we complement a healthcare organizations infrastructure, quickly driving sustainable improvements to net patient revenue and cash flows while reducing operating costs and enhancing the patient experience. We are looking for a self-motivated Senior Cybersecurity Analyst to join the R1 Cybersecurity Operations Team. We have a relentless focus on driving results for our customers and enabling them to invest more into patient care; in turn, this allows us to continue to grow our company and your career. The successful candidate must be well-versed in security operations, cyber security tools, intrusion detection, and secured networks. They will serve as an expert and be responsible for providing network and security operations technical analysis, assessment, and recommendations in the areas of real-time security situational awareness, operational network system and applications systems security monitoring. Responsibilities: Monitor various security tools to identify potential incidents, network intrusions, and malware events, etc., to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of R1s architecture and information systems are protected. Generate trouble tickets and perform initial validation and triage to determine whether incidents are security events using open-source intelligence (OSINT). Review and analyze log files to report any unusual or suspect activities. Utilize incident response use-case workflows to follow established and repeatable processes for triaging and escalating. Follow established incident response procedures to ensure proper escalation, analysis, and resolution of security incidents. Analyze and correlate incident event data to develop preliminary root cause and corresponding remediation strategy. Provide technical support for new detection capabilities, recommendations to improve upon existing tools/capabilities to protect R1s network, and assessments for High Value Assets. Research Threat Intelligence sources on the latest malware, trends, patches to keep the Security Program up to date. Document and maintain SOPs/Runbooks related to investigating security incidents. Perform case management throughout the incident lifecycle for moderately complex security incidents. Understand and assist with compliance and enterprise change management policies and procedures. Attend and participate in cybersecurity projects and the change management process. This includes interacting with business units and technical teams to understand what is coming and how their projects can be more secure from the beginning. Maintain metrics reports on the status of the R1 cybersecurity operations program. Provide the necessary trainings to team as and when required. Handling Escalations from Level 1 Required Qualifications: A bachelors degree in a technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Business Analyst, etc.) A minimum of 4-6 years of professional experience in an IT-related field. Intermediate knowledge of security, monitoring, and networking technologies, tools, protocols, and standards. Intermediate or advanced security, networking, or equivalent professional experience in security operations. Knowledge of security policy, programs, process, and metrics. Understanding/Experience on Network Security, Firewall Security, and Web Security (including web application firewalls and proxies). Experience on SIEM, PIM, Content Filtering, and Firewalls. Experience on Investigating, documenting, and reporting on any information security (InfoSec) issues as well as emerging trends. Experience Threat Hunting and searching for malicious activity. Strong drive and passion to deliver distinctive end-products, a quick learner with a strong attention to detail and quality. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Self-driven, with attention to detail and the ability to think outside the box for solutions to issues. Knowledge of IT Industry standards such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX. Good knowledge of security programs, process, and metrics. Good knowledge of IT Security Infrastructure and related applications and toolsets. Examples include firewalls Network, Active Directory, DNS. Desired Qualifications: Certification (or ability to obtain certification) in at least one of the following areas: General Security (CISSP), Cloud Security (GCLD, Cloud+, CCSK), and Ethical Hacking (CEH). Experience with advanced cybersecurity tools, network topologies, intrusion detection, and secured networks. In-depth understanding of NIST SP 800-61,SOC 2 AICPA controls, and frameworks. Recent experience with static and/or dynamic code review process. Experience with forensic data analysis. Leadership experience and qualities. Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests. Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package.
